Loss report: drone -> gitlab
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/build step.image: one job per run of steps that share an image, chained by needs; the workspace passes on as artifacts (GitLab sets the image per job, so the job is split into 2 jobs (ci-1, ci-2) chained by needs; each job hands the project directory minus .git to the next as artifacts that expire in 1 day, so the artifact size limit of the instance applies, files outside the project directory do not carry over, a file that an earlier job deletes comes back from the checkout in the next job, and every job repeats the services and variables of the source job. Timeout and retry apply to each job, so the total time can reach the timeout times the job count and a retry reruns only the failed job. An allow_failure setting applies to every job, and each later job first checks a marker file of the job before it and ends with success when the marker is missing)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/publish step.action: plugin image as the job image, entrypoint command as the script (the entrypoint command comes from pipemaster's plugin table (https://github.com/woodpecker-ci/plugin-docker-buildx/blob/main/Dockerfile); the settings are PLUGIN_ variables, the Woodpecker convention; the plugin starts a Docker daemon, so the runner must allow privileged containers)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/publish step.image: one job per run of steps that share an image, chained by needs; the workspace passes on as artifacts (the step runs in the split job ci-2)
